title: Choose the visual world
question: New style hand. Device Datasheet and its three comps are discarded. ANSI BBS was dropped: textmode on black is the console you already refused.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: The site is a departure board: Preview is the flight, grants are rows that have flipped, install is the gate.
options.viewport: A black board filling the fold. One yellow title row AKASHA OS. Rows under it: HOST, NVIDIA, NOT BOOTABLE, then GATE · INSTALL in red.
options.risk: Can read as a novelty clock if the flaps are decoration instead of the only navigation.

raised.raise: Horizon band: one long flap row owns the width. Not a stack of small cards.
Stamped seam: each grant is a flap that has already flipped, with a visible mechanical split.

options.label: Safety Card
options.thesis: The landing is a safety card: honesty is the first diagram, install is the brace-for-landing step.
options.viewport: A laminated sheet: panel 1 not a bootable OS, panel 2 NVIDIA, panel 3 Windows or Linux, panel 4 INSTALL.
options.risk: The most familiar ‘procedure as pictures’ destination for an install-first product.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: film cutting bench, orange flags, perforated rail
options.thesis: Grants hang as frames on one orange rail; the folded flag is where you install.
options.viewport: A black bench, one orange perforated rail across the fold, frames labeled session / gpu / net, a folded flag on INSTALL.
options.case: Holds product clarity: a flagged frame is a next step. Loses on audience identification: testers are not editors.
options.risk: Orange can swallow the honesty line if the rail is the only thing that reads.

options.label: Pulp Rack
options.thesis: Each route is a cover on a wire rack: Why, Grant, Install face out; the chosen cover is lipstick red.
options.viewport: Night-blue rack. One face-out cover: AKASHA OS, hook line not a bootable OS, red INSTALL as the dread line.
options.case: Holds audience identification: everyone can read a pulp cover. Loses on product clarity: lurid energy can lie about a host app.
options.risk: Do not paint invented people or guns. Covers are type and flat color only.

options.label: Centre Rail
options.thesis: Two short columns around a vermilion key rail; honesty lives in the annotation margin.
options.viewport: A small type block in a wide margin. Centre rail keys: grant, why, install. A vermilion note in the margin: not bootable, NVIDIA.
options.case: Holds product clarity for a manual. Loses on the chroma steer: bone and iron can feel as dull as the last hand.
options.risk: Reads as a scholarly reprint if the vermilion never owns a whole region.

options.label: Indoor Sun
options.thesis: The page is a sodium-amber hall; the thesis sits on the far wall as a half sun.
options.viewport: A long amber field, one half-disc, the honesty line low on the horizon, INSTALL as a silhouette at the foot.
options.case: Loses both axes: a light installation is not this cohort, and haze hides the NVIDIA limit.
options.kept: One horizon-wide band instead of a stack of small units.

options.label: Memory Quilt
options.thesis: Each grant is a cloth block with a date and a seam.
options.viewport: Unequal patches named session, gpu, net; a red stitch leads to INSTALL.
options.case: Loses both axes: a quilt invents domestic history the product does not have.
options.kept: A visible seam on every grant row, as if it already flipped.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark AI-OS hero, three feature cards, a Download button, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A night hero, a feature row, a primary download.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from neighboring agent desktops by design.
